overview_description.description: Prepared offers an AI-powered platform designed to enhance emergency response operations. The platform integrates functionalities such as automated triage for non-emergency calls, real-time translation of audio and text in multiple languages, and situational awareness tools including live video and multimedia sharing. It also provides quality assurance features that allow supervisors to evaluate call-taking performance in real-time. By consolidating these tools into a single interface, Prepared aims to assist public safety answering points in managing calls more efficiently and effectively.

about_short_description.short_description: Prepared offers an AI-powered platform designed to enhance emergency response operations.

product.name: Prepared Assist
product.description: An AI-powered platform that supports emergency call-taking and dispatch by integrating real-time multimedia and data to improve operational efficiency.

product.name: Prepared Live
product.description: A multimedia platform enabling emergency professionals to receive real-time video, photos, and text from 911 callers to enhance situational awareness during emergencies.

product.name: Non-Emergency Call Handling
product.description: A solution to reduce the workload of emergency call centers by managing non-emergency calls, lowering call-taker burnout and eliminating backlogs.

product.name: AI-Powered Call Translation
product.description: Automated translation of incoming audio and text in over 40 and 200 languages respectively, enabling seamless communication between callers and call-takers.
